---
title: "NYC Restaurant Inspections Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: columns
    vertical_layout: fill
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(p8105.datasets)

data("rest_inspec")

inspections = rest_inspec |>
  filter(
    !is.na(score),
    score >= 0,
    score <= 100,
    !is.na(boro),
    boro != "Missing"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    boro = factor(boro),
    grade = factor(
  grade,
  levels = c("A", "B", "C", "P", "Z", "N", "G")
)
  ) |>
  slice_sample(n = 15000)   
```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Inspection Scores by Borough

```{r}
p1 =
  plot_ly(
    data = inspections,
    x = ~boro,
    y = ~score,
    color = ~boro,
    type = "box",
    colors = "viridis"
  )

p1
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Number of Inspections by Grade

```{r}


p2 =
  inspections |>
  filter(!is.na(grade)) |>
  count(grade) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~grade,
    y = ~n,
    type = "bar",
    marker = list(
      color = "steelblue"
    )
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Number of Inspections by Grade",
    xaxis = list(title = "Inspection Grade"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Number of Inspections")
  )

p2
```

### Critical vs. Non-critical Violations

```{r}


p3 =
  inspections |>
  filter(!is.na(critical_flag)) |>
  count(critical_flag) |>
  plot_ly(
    labels = ~critical_flag,
    values = ~n,
    type = "pie",
    textinfo = "label+percent",
    hole = 0.3
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Proportion of Critical Violations"
  )

p3
```
